author: jak200814
body:
My ign is jak200814
      I have been playing on avicus for almost as long as I remember, I used to mainly play walls and nebula as they were my favorite games on the server but now with the new update i am playing all of the games on the server and am really enjoying them. As I have just started playing avicus again it might look like im not that great because of my lack of credits, but i have been playing pvp based servers since minecraft beta 1.8.2 when I started playing minecraft. I am an experienced pvper and an avicus old timer. I have skype and I hope that a team will want to have my team and I can't wait to see everyone on the battle feild.
